title: Justice Department Files to Intervene and Dismiss Lawsuit that Would Hamper America’s AI Innovation and Security

reading.body:
This incident involves a gas turbine power plant in Southaven, Mississippi that was constructed without required permits and operates to supply power to xAI's Colossus II data center. Multiple parties, including environmental and civil rights organizations, have filed legal action alleging violations of the Clean Air Act, with reporting indicating that pollution from the facility affects nearby communities disproportionately.

The failure is regulatory: a large infrastructure project supporting an AI system was deployed without obtaining the permits required by law for air quality compliance. What would have caught this is the standard permitting process that precedes such construction, which appears not to have been completed before operations began.

Not established by the reports is whether the violations were intentional, what specific remedies any court may order, or whether the Justice Department's intervention claim will succeed in dismissing the case.
